title: Receipt for the shabtis of Petekhons (BM EA 10800)
notes: Museum photo through glass. Script per the British Museum record quoted on the Commons page: 'Papyrus; Abnormal Hieratic text: receipt for shabtis of Petekhons.' The date comes from a second Commons photo of the same object (File:ShabtisPurchaseDocument-BritishMuseum-August21-08.jpg), which calls it 'hieratic', 21st Dynasty, c. 1070–945 BC. Borderline: the two sources label the script differently.
